speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of asthma or allergies, and do you currently smoke or have you ever smoked? I would also like to request a chest X-ray to evaluate for any underlying lung pathology.

text: Do you experience wheezing or chest tightness during these episodes, and do your symptoms improve with the use of a bronchodilator inhaler? I would also like to check your oxygen saturation and listen to your lung sounds.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: 10-year history of hypertension, currently managed with enalapril. History of smoking half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years. Social history: Smoker, half a pack of cigarettes daily for 16 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of hypertension and current use of enalapril, the dry cough may be a side effect of the medication. Do you experience any swelling in your legs or ankles, and does the cough improve when you lie flat?

speaker: Doctor
text: The spirometry confirms obstructive lung disease, likely COPD given your smoking history. Given the recent upper respiratory infection and normal chest X-ray, I suspect an acute exacerbation of COPD. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
